notes: Sourced from Luminex's official User Manual (GigaCore 26i, rev 2.8.8, section 7 "Technical Specifications"), which documents two variants: "GigaCore 26i Without PoE" and "GigaCore 26i With PoE". This entry models the PoE variant (sold as GigaCore 26i PoE / LU-01-00052-POE), which is a superset. Differences vs. the non-PoE variant (LU-01-00048 / LU-01-00052): non-PoE lacks the -54VDC/6.5A backup PoE input on the redundant power connector, has power consumption of 30W (vs 430W max with PoE), weighs 3.5kg (vs 4.0kg), and its 24 RJ45 ports are not PoE-capable. Both variants share identical connectivity: 24x RJ45 (10/100/1000Base-T, including 4 dual-media ports 21-24 shared with SFP), 6x SFP cages (10/100/1000Mbps Mini-GBIC, including the same 4 dual-media 21-24), 1x RJ45 serial console (RS232), 1x IEC mains inlet, and 1x Molex 14-pin connector for redundant/backup power. PoE is 802.3af/at, budget up to 370W (330W on Rev A hardware), only on ports 1-24. All RJ45/SFP network ports are Gigabit-only (10/100/1000Mbps) so graded eth-1g. The 4 "dual-media" ports (21-24/SFP5-6 equivalents) are modeled as separate RJ45 and SFP port entries per Luminex's own listing convention, since only one media type is active per port. Rack unit: 1U, 482 x 270.3 x 44mm.
